author: Dream_
text_post: Higher intakes of monounsaturated and saturated fat have been shown to increase testosterone levels, as well as increased intake of dietary cholesterol (eggs, red meat). Other foods like brocoli and almonds have been shown to help lower estrogen levels (which is the equivalent of increasing T). Foods like soy and beer increase E levels (which is the same as lowering T levels). High intensity muscular contractions have also been shown to increase growth hormone and T levels, compound movements like squatting/deadlifting especially. Aerobics has been shown to lower testosterone levels. hope this helps -Dream
